hooks: A message on Sunday at eleven
The customer who texts you at night
When they ask for a quote on Sunday

mensajes.texto: Hi, sorry it's late. How much for a closet?
Hi! First thing tomorrow I'll send you details.
It's urgent, I need a ballpark now.
Sure, it starts at the base model we posted.
Perfect, I'll confirm first thing tomorrow.
Morning! Did you get a chance to check the sizes?
Actually someone gave me a metal wardrobe.

contenido.remate: The urgency lasted until Monday morning

captions: They text you in a panic after hours, you answer right away so you do not lose the sale, and then they vanish into thin air.
Having your work, sizes and options clear on your website saves you from answering other people's emergencies at midnight.
The classic customer who's in a huge rush on Sunday at eleven and has forgotten all about it by Monday.
